conservative.requirements: without needing to curry favour. A sentient being (such as a human) must have just died within medium range. Effect: Play when a sentient being within medium range dies. Until the end of your next turn, all living beings within medium range of you are wracked by grief. Any affected that perform creature attempts to an action must make a {Dc} check opposed by your Discipline (WP). If they fail, the action is wasted and they do nothing instead.
conservative.name: Grief of the Goddess

reckless.requirements: 4 favour without needing to curry favour. A sentient being (such as a human) must have just died within medium range. Effect: Play when a sentient being within medium range dies. All living beings within medium range of you are wracked by grief. All affected creatures suffer 1 stress per character rank you have attained. The creature that killed the being that has just died must make a Discipline (WP) check opposed by your Discipline (WP). If he fails, he does nothing on his next turn, devastated by grief.
reckless.name: Grief of the Goddess
